test_cases.name: Quote Request for T-Shirts and Rugs with Attribute Clarification Needed
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for T-Shirts and Rugs, but does not specify the required attributes such as T-Shirt color or Rug size/material, necessitating clarification from the sales agent before a quote can be created.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: T-Shirts and Rugs (Attribute Details Needed)
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a quote for a few items for an upcoming event. Specifically, I am interested in ordering several T-Shirts as well as some Rugs. For the T-Shirts, I noticed there are multiple listings (Item No: AITEM-0022, AITEM-0023, AITEM-0024, AITEM-0025), but I am not sure what the differences are between them—are they different colors, sizes, or materials? I would like to get a quote for 30 T-Shirts, but I need more information about the available options so I can specify exactly which ones I want.

Similarly, I see there are several Rugs listed (Item No: AITEM-0030, AITEM-0031, AITEM-0032), but there are no details about their sizes, colors, or materials. Could you please provide clarification on the available variants for these Rugs? I am looking to order 5 rugs, but need to know the options before confirming.

Once I have the details on the available T-Shirt and Rug options, I will be able to specify my selections for the quote. Please let me know if you need any further information from my side.

Best regards,
Mario Adams

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for T-Shirts with missing and ambiguous attributes
test_cases.description: Emily Parker requests a quote for several T-Shirts, specifying some colors and leaving others ambiguous or missing. The request includes detailed context and explanations, but at least one line item is under-specified, requiring clarification from the SOA before a quote can be created.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for T-Shirts – Color and Size Clarification Needed
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a quote for a selection of T-Shirts for an upcoming event at Playlandia. We are looking for a mix of colors and sizes, but I am not entirely sure which variants are available in your catalog. Here are the details:

- 10 T-Shirts in golden yellow (if available; otherwise, please let me know what similar shades you offer)
- 15 T-Shirts in standard white (I am not sure if you have a basic white option, so please clarify)
- 8 T-Shirts in assorted colors (could you please specify which color options are currently in stock?)

Additionally, if there are any differences in material or fit (such as regular vs. slim), please let me know, as we want to ensure the best match for our team. I apologize if my request is a bit vague—I am hoping you can guide me through the available choices so we can finalize the order.

Best regards,
Emily Parker

If you need more details from me, just let me know!

Best regards,
Emily Parker
